Generation count is clamped to 1–50 (default 5); item i cycles through six textures (dots / stripes / grid / checkerboard / diagonal / waves) by i mod 6 unless a pattern type is chosen, in which case the whole batch uses it; the two colors c1, c2 and cell size default to random values (colors from a 10-color palette, size 8–64) and stay fixed once the color mode is switched to primary/background or a size is entered, so the previous result can be reproduced. Each texture is expressed in CSS: dots use radial-gradient with background-size; stripes use repeating-linear-gradient(90deg) with color stops at size/2; grid overlays two 1px linear-gradients at right angles; checkerboard uses a conic-gradient with four 90° sectors; diagonals use repeating-linear-gradient(45deg) with stops at size/4 and size/2; waves overlay two radial-gradient circles with background-size
